==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==

"I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis.



This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (I initially spent most of my time in one particular world in the Storyverse called the Elven Village, which I discovered on 06/11/2025.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, Skelebot, Overdrive, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow. Leon first appeared in my dreams on 06/11/2025.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet. I befriended him in a dream on 08/03/2025.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light. I created him in a dream on 09/06/2025. On the same day I created Second Brain, he helped me discover the much wider Storyverse. This was the start of my adventures to explore other Storyverse worlds.) (Overdrive is a robot with a metallic chrome color with spiky slicked back yellow hair and glowing green eyes. It wears a yellow shirt, yellow jacket, yellow pants, and yellow sneakers. They have the power to manipulate matter, and they were created in a dream on 10/20/2025.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars. I discovered the power of Lucid Light in a dream on 07/19/2025.) (Skelebot is a robot created by Johnson to act as the team's humanoid speedster. He was created in a dream on 09/21/2025.)



(My name is Jet. Here is a general description of what I look like ""Man with dark-brown skin, full dark-brown beard, long dark-brown dreadlocks spilling from beneath a black hoodie over a “Dream Anime” graphic tee, black athletic pants with a white stripe, white sneakers, black cross-body belt bag, warm brown eyes."")



I continued right where my last dream left off in the Marble Sky Palaces of the Super Cathedral (The Marble Sky Palaces resemble a world of golden clouds populated by marble palaces. It is high in the sky above the neon VR City biome cyberspace of the Super Cathedral.) alongside Savannah (A pale skinned cyborg woman with long black hair, bangs that covered her forehead, with glowing red eyes, and wearing a futuristic silver bodysuit. Her long black hair and bangs are key identifying features. She is wielding a futuristic purple and blue crystal sword known as the Death Sword.) her father Tecton (Tecton is a green skinned, humanoid, muscular, cat ogre, barbarian who dresses in a brown loin cloth and a silver baldric.), and my drone Chipper (Chipper resembles a small levitating silver crab robot). I have a rainbow sword (My rainbow sword resembles a colorful, futuristic, crystal sword.) and an energy tether (My energy tether resembles a rope made of golden glittery light.).



I was surprised to see the Marble Sky Palaces burning.



Savannah, Tecton, and Chipper had lit the palaces on fire out of boredom.



When I protested, they showed how easy it was for them to put all of the fires out.



They felt untouchable, but attacking the palaces themselves had summoned the wrath of Infinity.



Infinity resembled a giant pale woman with black eye rings, twilight blue hair with black stripes, and a sparkling twilight blue dress.



Infinity, as her name would suggest, was level infinity.



Using my rainbow crystal sword, I took off her head, but that wasn't enough to take her down as a level infinity being.



Leon, my ghostly green UFO, arrived just in time to use his tractor beam to launch Infinity's head into the Storyverse.



With her head stuck in another realm, her body lost connection to it and could no longer coordinate her actions.



Tecton, Savannah, Chipper, and I boarded Leon and took off into the Storyverse.



Thanks to the Dimension Door inside Leon, there is plenty of room for everyone to stay onboard.



The number of crew members aboard Leon is now fairly overwhelming, but not everyone who rides inside Leon is necessarily always around.



For now it seems like my adventures in the Marble Sky Palaces are over.



In my next dream, it seems like I'll be back exploring the greater Storyverse with Leon and the crew."
